narr: Two thunderstorm complexes moved through southern middle Tennessee during the early and mid morning hours of the 31st. Rainfall of 1.5 to 4.25 inches were reported during this time, resulting in flash flooding of a few roads.
ev: Highway 129 closed due to flash flooding.
Water covering Highway 50 at Owls Hollow Road.
Water covering North 2nd street and Mill Street. Roads impassable.
lsr: SEVERAL REPORTS OF ROADS CLOSED IN MOORE COUNTY TENNESSEE FROM FLOODING INCLUDING HIGHWAY 129.
WATER COVERING HIGHWAY 50 AT OWLS HOLLOW ROAD.
WATER COVERING NORTH 2ND STREET AND MILL STREET. ROADS IMPASSIBLE.
